tools.name: search_laravel_jobs
tools.description: Search recent Laravel jobs indexed by LaraBench, including full description, salary, seniority, and employment type. Results are limited to the last 30 days. Each job carries a LaraBench detail page and, when the source published one, the original apply URL.

tools.name: search_laravel_news
tools.description: Search recent Laravel ecosystem news and package releases indexed by LaraBench. Results are limited to the last 7 days. Each item carries a LaraBench detail page and the original article or release notes URL.
